environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to instance on port 8080. Application runs as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. SQLite database at /data/app.db with file permissions 0644. No request filtering or transformation at any layer.

config.security_groups: ALB: inbound 443/0.0.0.0/0; Instance: inbound 8080 from ALB SG only
